notes.title: 《Xuan-Yuan Sword: Mists Beyond the Mountains》DVD Edition Free Collection
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

To thank you for your support over the years, anyone who purchases the Steam version of "Xuanyuan Sword: The Beyond of the Cloud and the Mountain" can download the DVD version of "Xuanyuan Sword: The Beyond of the Cloud and the Mountain" released in 1999 for free in the form of DLC, and join your Steam collection.

[h3][b]Note 1: In order to play normally, please be sure to update the game
Note 2: The DVD version is a stand-alone game and does not support additional functions. Please read the following instructions carefully before installing[/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*]The resolution will be locked when playing (the game will be restored after leaving the game), and the low resolution will be maintained if the game is switched back to the desktop midway.
[*] Languages ​​other than Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese are not supported.
[*]No support for handle operation, Steam achievements, 16:9 screen, auto save, etc.
[*] The game may not be able to run properly due to not supporting some systems and hardware.
[*] Provide Steam cloud archive, Steam version and DVD version are independently archived (do not mix them).
[/olist]

[h3][b]Please go to the Steam store to add or directly download the "Xuan-Yuan Sword: Mists Beyond the Mountains" DLC. [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43987885/1e8f1fbfd58b6eccbf4db50c1e5b1e4b033dc768.png[/img]

[h3]Start instructions[/h3]
[b]1. Start the game on Steam, and click "Advanced" after the startup interface appears. [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43987885/4d5e5d7bce7ff2ce88650dd37a02126a72c80688.png[/img]

[b]2. After the following interface appears, click "Install DLC" (you can also download it directly from the Steam page). [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43987885/2785332c62bd9e7b2c1aa0a63c4938a35beace01.png[/img]

[b]3. After the download is complete, you will see the "DVD version (1999 edition), select the language (Simplified Chinese or Traditional Chinese), and click "Start" to play.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43987885/1b5ce11eb7df64ab189da8f0a4e7e4e681102e4d.png[/img]

[h3] Compatibility troubleshooting method[/h3]
※When executing the DVD version of the game and the following screen errors appear, you can follow the steps below to deal with them
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43987885/ce12b0824e8f77d72131ba3b6c50a9a45755abbe.png[/img]

[b]1. Select Steam > Content[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43987885/62c37ea2609245b95a39950b0b1b9b589ecbd664.png[/img]

[b]2. Select "Installed Files" > Browse (open the installation directory SWD3 folder)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43987885/8d5a4eaacb4ebaaa2ab00c2cda5a1ac00b539848.png[/img]

[b]3. In the installation directory SWD3 folder > select "Swd3DVD folder"[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43987885/177f46a152ee3ed810e617e24ce15c452ed67ed9.png[/img]

[b]4. In the Swd3DVD folder > click the right mouse button on "Swd3DVD.exe" > select "Content" > in the "Settings" option: check the reduced color mode, 16-bit (66536) color[/ b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43987885/9b1753306c548eb576cd00a9d20cce9e5ca8b846.png[/img]

[h1]BUG correction[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Corrected items such as Agave, Boluohui Root, Prison Lark Grass, Sea Lemon Fruit, Limeberry, Keelwood, Acacia Bud, Wisteria Leaf, Corydalis Flower, Acacia, Dodder Demon , for use against the enemy.
[*] Fixed incorrect calculation of player resistance.
[*] Fixed using the space bar to set the equipment to activate 2 times.
[/olist]

notes.title: Xuan-Yuan Sword: Mists Beyond the Mountains Release Date Reveal
notes.content:
Xuan-Yuan Sword: Mists Beyond the Mountains, the award-winning classic RPG will come to Steam on July 26th! Check out the latest trailer.

[previewyoutube=pMbjYAgMiPU;full][/previewyoutube]

The long-running historical fantasy franchise Xuan-Yuan Sword is one of the most successful games IP in Chinese-speaking territories. Mists Beyond the Mountains, its third installment, was originally released in 1999; this remaster edition brings the original to new platforms, respecting the original art, rich story rooted in Chinese fantasy and real historical events, and deep gameplay that made Mists Beyond the Mountains a critical and commercial success.

The game offers free exploration of its vast world, along with epic fights based on the Active Time Battle system, also features a unique crafting system: players can of course gather ingredients to craft new gear, but they can also use an item called the Spirit Fusion Pot to capture enemies in battles, which in turn can be used in special Altars to craft not only items but monsters too. Using Eastern or Western altars brings different results to the final item.

[h3]Improvements and changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] 16:9 high-resolution graphic
[*] UI rework
[*] High-resolution item texture
[*] Controller support
[*] China Episode, originally added in mobile version
[/list]

The game will also be released on Nintendo Switch later this year; a demo of this version will be available at the BitSummit this weekend.

notes.title: 《轩辕剑叁：云和山的彼端》即将登录Steam平台
notes.content:
方块游戏将与Gamera Games联合发行轩辕剑系列经典游戏《轩辕剑叁：云和山的彼端》，Steam商店页面已公开，欢迎加入愿望单！

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1638230
 《轩辕剑叁：云和山的彼端》是由大宇资讯开发的经典回合制角色扮演游戏，讲述了主人公赛特为求真理，从威尼斯出发，途经地中海、阿拉伯等地，最后到达大唐帝国。一路上与形形色色的人物遭遇，发生了各种各样的故事。
 
本作承袭优美传统的国画风格，横跨整个欧亚大陆，贯穿法兰克、阿拉伯、中国三个文明，将历史舞台与中西神话完美结合。
 
本次《轩辕剑叁：云和山的彼端》相比初版本进行了全方位的优化并补充了新的内容，详情如下：
[list]
[*] 画面比例优化16:9（旧版为4:3）
[*] 支持高清晰度（旧版为640*480）
[*] 物品贴图高清化
[*] 优化界面操作
[*] 支持手柄操作
[*] 包含手机版新增的中国篇剧情[/list]
其中手机版新增的中国篇剧情，将丰富主角赛特在当时中国唐朝中发生的剧情。而当中究竟有什么样的新境遇，以及会迸发什么样的新火花，届时欢迎各位玩家前去挖掘！

tags.feature: 包含手机版新增的中国篇剧情
